name: Stylized Rounded Components
author: Suma
description: Reconstructs noisy AI mesh assemblies as clean rounded components, or conservatively remeshes and smooths their existing silhouettes.

params_schema.label: Preset
params_schema.tooltip: Choose a tested preset. Select Custom Parameters to use every control below verbatim.

params_schema.label: Mode
params_schema.tooltip: Reconstruct separate pieces as rounded cuboids, or regularize and smooth their current silhouettes.

params_schema.label: Min Volume
params_schema.tooltip: Relative bounding-box volume threshold compared with the largest component.

params_schema.label: Remove Fragments
params_schema.tooltip: Remove pieces beneath the relative minimum-volume threshold.

params_schema.label: Dimension %
params_schema.tooltip: Upper robust dimension percentile; 98 uses the 2nd–98th percentile and ignores extreme spikes.

params_schema.label: Bevel Ratio
params_schema.tooltip: Bevel radius as a fraction of the smallest reconstructed dimension.

params_schema.label: Bevel Segments
params_schema.tooltip: Rounded-edge segment count. Three is the soft-stone default.

params_schema.label: Asymmetry
params_schema.tooltip: Broad deterministic top-corner variation. Never adds high-frequency noise.

params_schema.label: Smooth Iterations
params_schema.tooltip: Low-strength Taubin smoothing passes used by Smooth Existing.

params_schema.label: Smooth Strength
params_schema.tooltip: Taubin lambda. Conservative values preserve volume and gaps.

params_schema.label: Target Faces
params_schema.tooltip: Optional whole-output triangle budget. Zero disables decimation.

params_schema.label: Keep Materials
params_schema.tooltip: Keep the first input material, or emit one neutral slot for the downstream Texture Mesh node.

params_schema.label: Merge Output
params_schema.tooltip: Combine all processed components into one mesh while retaining disconnected geometry.

params_schema.label: Recalc Normals
params_schema.tooltip: Generate coherent smooth vertex normals after reconstruction or smoothing.

params_schema.label: Hard Edge Angle
params_schema.tooltip: Preserve a hard edge only above this angle. Rounded reconstruction normally has none.
